name: Backlink Profile Assessment
description: User wants to understand their site's backlink health.
userMessage: Can you analyze the backlink profile of example.com? I want to know if I have any toxic links.
expectedBehavior: If API unavailable, explains what API key is needed and provides manual methodology
If API available, assesses backlink quality using the scoring framework
Identifies potentially toxic links using the TOXIC_LINK_PATTERNS criteria
Analyzes anchor text distribution for over-optimization
Explains when to disavow vs when to ignore
